summary_1line: Genealogies of gods, animals, and demons are given, linking many Asuras and deities to human figures of the Mahabharata, including the Pandavas and Kauravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Bhrigu bursts forth by ripping open the breast of Brahman in a dramatic act of cosmic birth.
Young Abhimanyu charges alone into the complex Chakra-vyuha battle formation, surrounded by ranks of enemy warriors.
The maiden Pritha secretly invokes the sun god Surya, who appears in radiant light before her.
